audit_name: OPS-02 C18 GPU Infrastructure and Execution Protocol Specification

authoritative_execution_policy.rationale: Single-device execution eliminates inter-GPU gradient reduction latency, avoids non-deterministic multi-GPU batch scattering, simplifies BatchNorm synchronization, and preserves cloud quota. Provisioning dual GPUs when PyTorch code only targets cuda:0 wastes cloud quota and misrepresents compute efficiency (GOV-RULE-087).
authoritative_execution_policy.future_kernel_provisioning_rule: Future Kaggle kernels must specify single accelerator provisioning or explicitly implement DistributedDataParallel (DDP) if multi-GPU training is intended.

mandatory_logged_fields: peak_training_vram_mb (measured via torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() during training, NOT eval warmup)

c16_remediation_summary.remedial_classification: C16 Replicate 003 is recognized as a valid single-GPU run. Future run reports must explicitly declare 'Single GPU on Kaggle Runtime' rather than 'Dual T4 Execution'.
